IDS_CONSUMER_UPDATE_PROGRESS_SUBTITLE.t: Dobijate najnovije ažuriranje softvera s najnovijim sigurnosnim ispravkama i funkcijama.

IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.en:
BEGIN_H3Debugging FeaturesEND_H3
          BR
          You can enable the debugging features on your NickelOS device in order to install and test custom code on your device.  This will allow you to:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRemove rootfs verification so you can modify OS files
            LIST_ITEMEnable SSH access to the device using the standard test keys so you can use tools such as BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE to access the device
            LIST_ITEMEnable booting from USB so you can install an OS image from a USB drive
            LIST_ITEMSet both the dev and the system root login password to a custom value so you can manually SSH into the device
          END_LIST
          BR
          Once enabled, most of the debugging features will remain enabled even after performing a powerwash or wiping the data on an enterprise managed device.  To fully disable all debugging features, reinstall NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          For more information about the debugging features see:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNote:END_BOLD  The system will reboot during the process.
IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.t:
BEGIN_H3Funkcije za otklanjanje grešakaEND_H3
          BR
          Možete omogućiti funkcije za otklanjanje grešaka na NickelOS uređaju da instalirate i testirate prilagođeni kôd na svom uređaju.  Ovo će vam omogućiti sljedeće:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMuklanjanje potvrde rootfs da možete izmijeniti fajlove operativnog sistema
            LIST_ITEMomogućavanje SSH pristupa uređaju koristeći standardne ključeve za testiranje da možete koristiti alate kao što su BEGIN_CODE"cros flash"END_CODE za pristup uređaju
            LIST_ITEMomogućavanje pokretanja sistema s USB-a da možete instalirati sliku operativnog sistema s USB diska
            LIST_ITEMpostavljanje dev i sistemske korijenske lozinke za prijavu na prilagođenu vrijednost da možete ručno pristupiti uređaju koristeći SSH
          END_LIST
          BR
          Nakon što se omoguće, većina funkcija za otklanjanje grešaka će ostati omogućena čak i nakon što se izvrši Powerwash ili uništavanje podataka na uređaju kojim upravlja preduzeće.  Da potpuno onemogućite sve funkcije za otklanjanje grešaka, ponovo instalirajte NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          Više informacija o funkcijama za otklanjanje grešaka potražite ovdje:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNapomena:END_BOLD sistem će se ponovo pokrenuti za vrijeme ovog postupka.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Everything ready to go, and private. DuckDuckGo searches the web from the browser and the launcher, uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in the browser, Proton's private apps (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass and more) are installed, and free, open-source apps come with it: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive and more.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.t: Sve je spremno za upotrebu i privatno. DuckDuckGo pretražuje web iz preglednika i Pokretača, uBlock Origin blokira oglase i alate za praćenje u pregledniku, instalirane su Protonove privatne aplikacije (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass i druge), a uz to dolaze i besplatne aplikacije otvorenog koda: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive i druge.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Just the basics. The launcher searches only this computer, and nothing else is set up for you.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.t: Samo osnove. Pokretač pretražuje samo ovaj računar i ništa drugo se ne postavlja za vas.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.en: You can change all of this later in Settings.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.t: Sve ovo možete kasnije promijeniti u Postavkama.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_TITLE.en: How would you like to start?

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.en: Before starting, make sure you have a backup of your data. Installing DEVICE_OS will overwrite the disk you choose.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.t: Prije nego što počnete, provjerite jeste li napravili sigurnosnu kopiju podataka. Ako instalirate DEVICE_OS, zamijenit će se svi podaci na disku koji odaberete.

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.en: DEVICE_OS is free software provided as is: it may not work on every computer, and its authors are not responsible for any data loss.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.t: DEVICE_OS je slobodni softver koji se pruža „kakav jeste“: možda neće funkcionirati na svakom računaru, a njegovi autori nisu odgovorni za bilo kakve gubitke podataka.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: When your screen is idle, show your pictures, time, and media info
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Kada je ekran neaktivan, prikazuj vaše slike, sat i informacije o mediju

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows the pictures in your Pictures folder and the folders in it. Add at least 2.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Čuvar ekrana prikazuje slike iz foldera Pictures i foldera u njemu. Dodajte najmanje 2.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows NickelOS's wallpapers. Turn this on to show the pictures in My files > Pictures instead.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Čuvar ekrana prikazuje pozadinske slike za NickelOS. Uključite ovo da se umjesto njih prikazuju slike iz foldera Moji fajlovi > Pictures.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: From Open-Meteo, for your approximate location, which beaconDB works out from your internet address
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Od usluge Open-Meteo, za vašu približnu lokaciju, koju beaconDB određuje na osnovu vaše IP adrese

IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.en: Make sure your printer is turned on and connected to the same network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable
IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.t: Provjerite je li štampač uključen i povezan s istom mrežom s kojom je povezan i NickelOS uređaj ili koristite USB kabl

IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.en: When on, data is saved in your Google Account and can be used on all your devices. When off, data is saved only to this device. For NickelOS sync options, go to LINK_BEGINNickelOS settingsLINK_END.
IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.t: Kada je uključeno, podaci se pohranjuju na Google računu i mogu se koristiti na svim vašim uređajima. Kada je isključeno, podaci se pohranjuju samo na ovom uređaju. Za opcije sinhronizacije NickelOS-a, idite u LINK_BEGINpostavke NickelOS-aLINK_END.

IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device. Permission will be requested each time you plug in a USB device. Individual Android apps will ask for additional permissions.
IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.t: Omogućite Android aplikacijama da upravljaju USB uređajima na ovom NickelOS uređaju. Tražit će se odobrenje svaki put kada priključite USB uređaj. Zasebne Android aplikacije će tražiti dodatna odobrenja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Uređaj više ne prima sigurnosna i softverska ažuriranja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Ovaj uređaj više ne prima ažuriranja

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Uređaj više ne prima sigurnosna i softverska ažuriranja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Ovaj uređaj više ne prima ažuriranja

IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device
IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.t: Omogućite Android aplikacijama da upravljaju USB uređajima na ovom NickelOS uređaju

IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.en: This option applies to NickelOS devices with a data plan or mobile network dongle, or when tethering to a portable hotspot
IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.t: Ova opcija se primjenjuje na NickelOS uređaje s paketom prijenosa podataka ili ključem za mobilnu mrežu ili prilikom dijeljenja internetske veze putem prijenosne pristupne tačke.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.en: You'll be signed out. On the sign-in screen, the new person chooses a name, a username and a password.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.t: Bit ćete odjavljeni. Na ekranu za prijavu nova osoba bira ime, korisničko ime i lozinku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.en: Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.t: Administratori mogu instalirati softver za sve, mijenjati sistem i upravljati računima.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_FAILED.t: Došlo je do greške. Pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.en: This device needs at least one administrator
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.t: Ovaj uređaj mora imati najmanje jednog administratora

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_MAKE_ADMIN_.t: Želite li da NAME postane administrator?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.en: No one else has an account on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.t: Niko drugi nema račun na ovom uređaju.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.en: Everyone has their own account and files. Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.t: Svako ima vlastiti račun i fajlove. Administratori mogu instalirati softver za sve, mijenjati sistem i upravljati računima.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_ADMI.t: Želite li da NAME postane standardni korisnik?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.en: Their account and all their files are deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.t: Račun te osobe i svi njeni fajlovi se brišu s ovog uređaja. Ovo se ne može poništiti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.en: Only an administrator of this device can change these.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.t: Samo administrator ovog uređaja može mijenjati ove postavke.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.en: For apps built only for the ARM processors phones use, many games among them. Proprietary software, downloaded when you turn it on.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.t: Za aplikacije napravljene samo za ARM procesore koje koriste telefoni, među kojima su i mnoge igre. Vlasnički softver koji se preuzima kada ga uključite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: Many Android apps, games especially, are built only for the ARM processors phones use. To run them on this computer, Android needs a translator. NickelOS doesn't make or include one: turning this on downloads TRANSLATOR from GitHub, the same copy the Waydroid community's waydroid_script installs.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Mnoge Android aplikacije, posebno igre, napravljene su samo za ARM procesore koje koriste telefoni. Da bi se pokretale na ovom računaru, Androidu je potreban prevodilac. NickelOS ga ne pravi niti uključuje: kada ovo uključite, s GitHuba se preuzima TRANSLATOR, ista kopija koju instalira waydroid_script zajednice Waydroid.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: It's proprietary software, under its owner's terms, and you're the one installing it. Some apps may run slowly or not at all. Android restarts to use it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: To je vlasnički softver koji podliježe uslovima svog vlasnika i vi ga instalirate. Neke aplikacije mogu raditi sporo ili uopće ne raditi. Android se ponovo pokreće da bi ga koristio.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_T.t: Želite li uključiti podršku za ARM aplikacije?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.en: The download didn't finish. Check your connection, then try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.t: Preuzimanje nije dovršeno. Provjerite vezu, a zatim pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_FAILED.t: Došlo je do greške. Pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.en: Deletes Android, your Android apps and their data
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.t: Briše Android, vaše Android aplikacije i njihove podatke

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.en: Android, your Android apps and their data are deleted from this device. Other people who use it keep their Android data, but can't open their Android apps until Android is set up again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.t: Android, vaše Android aplikacije i njihovi podaci se brišu s ovog uređaja. Druge osobe koje ga koriste zadržavaju svoje Android podatke, ali ne mogu otvoriti svoje Android aplikacije dok se Android ponovo ne postavi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.en: Android apps open in their own windows, next to your other apps. Setting up downloads Android (LineageOS, from the Waydroid project): about 1 GB, and 2.5 GB on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.t: Android aplikacije se otvaraju u vlastitim prozorima, pored ostalih aplikacija. Postavljanjem se preuzima Android (LineageOS, iz projekta Waydroid): oko 1 GB, a na ovom uređaju zauzima 2,5 GB.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.en: Android apps aren't available right now.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.en: Android uses SIZE on this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.t: Android zauzima SIZE na ovom uređaju

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.en: See Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other cloud storage in Files
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.t: Pregledajte Google Disk, OneDrive, Dropbox i drugu pohranu u oblaku u Fajlovima

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DONE.t: Račun ACCOUNT_NAME je sada u Fajlovima.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.en: Google Drive needs your own client ID and secret from the Google Cloud console.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.t: Google Disku su potrebni vaš vlastiti ID klijenta i tajna iz konzole Google Cloud.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.en: Couldn't connect. Check the details and try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.t: Povezivanje nije uspjelo. Provjerite podatke i pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.en: NickelOS uses rclone to show your cloud storage in Files, so your files are easy to reach. Choose a service to sign in to.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.t: NickelOS koristi rclone da prikaže pohranu u oblaku u Fajlovima, kako bi vaši fajlovi bili lako dostupni. Odaberite uslugu na koju se želite prijaviti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.en: Files stops showing this account. Your files stay in the cloud, and you can add the account again later.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.t: Fajlovi više neće prikazivati ovaj račun. Vaši fajlovi ostaju u oblaku, a račun možete ponovo dodati kasnije.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.en: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.t: Završite prijavu na stranici koja se otvorila u pregledniku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.en: When you connect, the service's sign-in page opens in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.t: Kada se povežete, stranica za prijavu usluge otvorit će se u pregledniku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_TWO_FACTOR.t: Kôd za potvrdu u 2 koraka (ako je koristite)

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.en: Only an administrator of this computer can change its name.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.t: Samo administrator ovog računara može promijeniti njegov naziv.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.en: Other devices see this name on your network and over Bluetooth, and the Terminal and Linux apps show it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.t: Drugi uređaji vide ovaj naziv na vašoj mreži i putem Bluetootha, a prikazuju ga i Terminal i Linux aplikacije.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.en: The name couldn't be changed. Try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.t: Promjena naziva nije uspjela. Pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.en: Use at least one letter from A to Z or a number.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.t: Koristite barem jedno slovo od A do Z ili broj.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.en: The apps that open each kind of file, from Files and from Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.t: Aplikacije koje otvaraju svaku vrstu fajla iz Fajlova i iz Linux aplikacija

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.en: Drives inside this device besides the one with NickelOS. The drive that holds Windows opens read-only, so Windows stays intact.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.t: Diskovi u ovom uređaju osim onog na kojem je NickelOS. Disk na kojem je Windows otvara se samo za čitanje, tako da Windows ostaje netaknut.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.en: Windows is on this drive. It's read-only unless you allow changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.t: Windows je na ovom disku. Disk je samo za čitanje osim ako ne dozvolite promjene.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.en: With Fast Startup, Windows doesn't fully shut down, and changes made here can be lost or damage files when Windows starts again. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows, or hold Shift while you shut Windows down, before you make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.t: Uz Brzo pokretanje, Windows se ne isključuje potpuno, pa se promjene napravljene ovdje mogu izgubiti ili oštetiti fajlove kada se Windows ponovo pokrene. Prije nego što napravite promjene, isključite Brzo pokretanje u Windowsu ili držite tipku Shift dok isključujete Windows.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.en: Allow changes to the Windows drive?
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.t: Želite li dozvoliti promjene na Windows disku?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.en: Windows didn't shut down fully, so the drive stays read-only. Shut down Windows fully to make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.t: Windows se nije potpuno isključio, pa disk ostaje samo za čitanje. Potpuno isključite Windows da biste mogli unositi promjene.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.en: The forum, Discord and GitHub, on nickelos.dev
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.t: Forum, Discord i GitHub na nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.en: Portage and emerge from the start, with pacman and apt commands side by side
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.t: Portage i emerge od samog početka, uporedo s komandama za pacman i apt

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.en: How NickelOS works. This copy came with your version of NickelOS and works offline.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.t: Kako NickelOS funkcionira. Ova kopija je došla uz vašu verziju sistema NickelOS i radi van mreže.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_MENU_ITEM_DESCR.t: Vodič, učenje sistema Gentoo, rješavanje problema

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.en: Logs, crash reports, and the usual problems and their fixes
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.t: Zapisnici, izvještaji o padu i uobičajeni problemi s rješenjima

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.en: With the KDE Connect app on Android or iPhone, on the same Wi‑Fi network
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.t: Pomoću aplikacije KDE Connect na Androidu ili iPhoneu, na istoj WiFi mreži

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.en: No phones or tablets yet. Install KDE Connect from Google Play, F‑Droid or the App Store, open it on the same Wi‑Fi network, then pair from either device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.t: Još nema telefona ni tableta. Instalirajte KDE Connect s Google Playa, F-Droida ili App Storea, otvorite ga na istoj WiFi mreži, a zatim uparite s bilo kojeg uređaja.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.en: The phone connection isn't running. Sign out and back in to start it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.t: Veza s telefonom nije pokrenuta. Odjavite se i ponovo se prijavite da je pokrenete.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.en: Wants to pair with this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.t: Želi se upariti s ovim uređajem

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.en: Lets apps such as Discord use push-to-talk while you're in other windows. They see keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt or Search and function keys, never what you type.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.t: Omogućava aplikacijama kao što je Discord da koriste funkciju pritisni-za-razgovor dok ste u drugim prozorima. Vide tipke pritisnute uz Ctrl, Alt ili tipku za pretraživanje te funkcijske tipke, ali nikada ono što kucate.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.en: Shortcut keys for older Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.t: Tipke prečica za starije Linux aplikacije

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.en: Make sure your printer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable. LINK_BEGINLearn more about compatibilityLINK_END
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.t: Provjerite je li štampač povezan s istom WiFi mrežom s kojom je povezan i NickelOS uređaj ili koristite USB kabl. LINK_BEGINSaznajte više o kompatibilnostiLINK_END

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.en: Can’t connect to printer. Check that the printer is turned on and is connected to your NickelOS device by Wi-Fi or USB.
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.t: Nije moguće povezati se na štampač. Provjerite je li štampač uključen i je li povezan na vaš NickelOS uređaj putem WiFi-ja ili USB-a.

IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.en: To get started, please make sure your USB or Bluetooth switch is connected to your NickelOS device. You can also use keyboard keys.
IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.t: Da započnete, provjerite je li USB ili Bluetooth prekidač povezan s NickelOS uređajem. Možete koristiti i tipke na tastaturi.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.t: Da otključate NickelOS uređaj, provjerite je li Bluetooth na telefonu uključen

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.en: Your NickelOS device’s Bluetooth is off. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.t: Bluetooth na vašem NickelOS uređaju je isključen. Da otključate NickelOS uređaj, unesite lozinku.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.en: Your phone doesn’t have a lock screen. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.t: Vaš telefon nema zaključani ekran. Da otključate NickelOS uređaj, unesite lozinku.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, first unlock your phone
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.t: Da otključate NickelOS uređaj, najprije otključajte telefon

IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.en: Your device uses a built-in sensor to detect people in front of it. All data is processed on your device immediately and then deleted. Sensor data is never sent to Google.
IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.t: Uređaj koristi ugrađeni senzor da otkrije osobe koje se nalaze ispred njega. Svi podaci se odmah obrađuju na uređaju, a zatim se brišu. Podaci senzora se nikada ne šalju Googleu.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.en: You’ll sign in to your device with your own account, and everyone who uses it can have one.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.t: Na uređaj ćete se prijavljivati vlastitim računom, a svako ko ga koristi može imati svoj.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.en: Your own account on your device

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.en: NickelOS is designed with security in mind, and it keeps itself up to date automatically.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.t: NickelOS je dizajniran s naglaskom na sigurnost i sam se automatski ažurira.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.en: NickelOS runs web apps and Linux apps side by side. Get apps for productivity, entertainment, and more.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.t: NickelOS pokreće web aplikacije i Linux aplikacije jedne uz druge. Preuzmite aplikacije za produktivnost, zabavu i još mnogo toga.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.en: This is the only time you’ll wait for an update. On NickelOS, software updates happen in the background.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.t: Ovo je jedini put kada ćete čekati ažuriranje. Na NickelOS-u se softver ažurira u pozadini.

IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.en: Chrome apps don’t run on NickelOS. Consider an alternative app.
IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.t: Chromeove aplikacije ne funkcioniraju na NickelOS-u. Razmislite o korištenju alternativne aplikacije.
